intent_dna: Apply Audit Bot in realtime, at every approved modification gate, and during internal integrity audits without granting automatic merge, deployment, or self-approval.
capability_gap: Audit Bot v1 was a manual CLI and its approval and learning ledgers lacked complete concurrency, receipt-binding, backpressure, recovery, and Windows CI coverage.
proposed_change: Connect approval synchronization and mandatory audit queues to the 15-second relay, add deployment-baseline internal audits, harden approval and learning ledgers, quarantine corrupt jobs, and add Windows control CI.
expected_benefit: Every verified change and deployed control is continuously checked against owner-approved scope and tamper-evident bounded ledgers.
risks: A strict gate may hold a legitimate change until evidence or baseline is corrected.
A stale or missing deployment baseline causes HOLD.
Backpressure stops new learning records after the configured retention ceiling.
validation_plan: Prove approval-ledger and learning-ledger concurrent writers are rejected.
Prove duplicate feedback and receipt reuse are rejected.
Prove segment rotation preserves the global hash chain and applies backpressure.
Prove malformed audit jobs are quarantined while later valid jobs continue.
Prove protected-file drift and ledger tampering are BLOCKED.
Run Linux full regression, PostgreSQL CI, and Windows audit-control CI.
